stories.summary: Donald Trump and six technology executives signed a voluntary White House accord committing to the safe development of AI, which the administration called “Super Intelligence.” Under Trump’s signature, the document misspelled his title as “President of the Unites States.”

stories.title: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
stories.summary: Hamas released four female Israeli soldiers under the multiphase Gaza ceasefire agreement. They were the second group of hostages freed since the deal took effect, raising hopes that the arrangement could lead to a lasting end to the war.

links.headline: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
links.excerpt: The hostages are the second set to be released since the multiphase agreement came into effect, raising hopes for a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: The world’s three largest container operators remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting ships. They cited instability in Gaza and wider regional tensions as reasons the route may still be dangerous.

links.headline: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
links.excerpt: The world’s top three container operators said they fear instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions mean continued danger.
